name: redis
description: Bun native Redis client with get/set/del and publish/subscribe, plus demo cache endpoints.
env: # redis uses REDIS_URL or the REDIS_HOST / REDIS_PORT / REDIS_USERNAME / REDIS_PASSWORD / REDIS_DB settings defined above
instructions: Start Redis:  docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d
For production, prefer REDIS_URL; authenticated host settings are also supported.
Set a value:  curl -XPUT localhost:5002/cache/greeting -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"value":"hi","ttl":60}'
